title: Eletre
sources:
- [Edmunds — 2025 Eletre pricing](https://www.edmunds.com/car-news/2025-lotus-eletre-pricing-announced.html)
- [CarBuzz — 2025 Eletre specs](https://carbuzz.com/cars/lotus/eletre/2025/)
- [DuPont Registry — Eletre US orders](https://news.dupontregistry.com/lotus/lotus-eletre-available-order-us/)
- [Lotus Cars US — Eletre](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-US/eletre)
infotainment: Lotus Hyper OS on 15.1-inch OLED touchscreen, second row 9-inch screen, KEF 15-speaker 1,380W audio standard; NVIDIA Drive Orin compute platform
adasStandard: Lotus 'Highway Assist' Level 2 with adaptive cruise control, lane centering, automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, traffic sign recognition. Built on NVIDIA Drive Orin compute with 34 sensors, 12 cameras, 4 LiDAR units. Source: [DuPont Registry](https://news.dupontregistry.com/lotus/lotus-eletre-available-order-us/).
adasOptional: Data unavailable: Lotus does not publish a separate optional ADAS tier for 2025 Eletre base trim in US press materials; the full sensor stack is standard.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear-view camera integrated with the 15.1-inch OLED touchscreen. Dynamic guidelines included. No published resolution spec from Lotus. Source: [Lotus Eletre specifications](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-US/eletre).
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard surround-view 360-degree camera system. Digital side mirror cameras (replacing conventional side mirrors) are available in some global markets but the US Eletre retains conventional power-folding side mirrors. Source: [Electrek Eletre guide](https://electrek.co/guides/lotus-eletre/).
subscriptionFeatures: **Lotus Connect Prestige** — paid subscription tier providing enhanced remote services (advanced location/security, premium navigation, in-car app store, certain comfort features). Pricing not publicly disclosed in US market as of May 2026; the base Lotus Connect tier is bundled with the vehicle for an unspecified initial period. No documented heated-seat-as-subscription model. Source: [The Lotus Forums - Prestige](https://forums.thelotusforums.com/topic/124763-lotus-prestige-ends-on-november-30th/).
drmNotes: Lotus Connect / Hyper OS infotainment is cellular-connected; core vehicle drive functions operate without an active data connection, but features such as live navigation, OTA updates, remote app control (climate, charge), in-car streaming, and most voice services require connectivity. Lotus Connect's basic tier ships with the car; enhanced Lotus Connect Prestige is a paid subscription. Backend services rely on Geely / Lotus Technology infrastructure. Source: [Lotus Connect](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-GB/lotus-connect).
killSwitchNotes: No IIJA impaired-driving-detection kill switch is implemented on the 2025 Eletre. The car has a driver monitoring camera used for Highway Assist attention monitoring, but it does not actively prevent vehicle operation based on impairment detection.
knownIssues: Early Eletre owners on TheLotusForums and LotusTalk report: faulty 12V super-capacitor causing 12V battery drain; accelerated cold-weather range/battery loss; wheel stone-chipping; minor interior trim quality complaints. Source: [LotusTalk Eletre problems thread](https://www.lotustalk.com/threads/lotus-eletre-problems.549582/).
recalls: Data unavailable: no NHTSA recall campaigns issued for 2025 US-market Eletre as of May 2026 per [NHTSA recall database](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls) (verified via search; no Eletre VINs returned).
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: state-by-state EV incentives vary; many state programs (e.g., California CVRP) historically excluded vehicles above ~$60-80k MSRP, which would exclude the Eletre. Recommend checking individual state DMV/clean-vehicle program for current eligibility.
